task: Add a session-refresh helper so an expired token re-signs in without a full reload.

reviewer.claim: The effect never re-runs, so a token that expires mid-session is never refreshed.
refreshSession() is called without awaiting or checking the result.

contraire.claim: Setting window.location.href discards in-flight UI state, which is worse than the 401 it is handling.
